partial_case.facts: The resident reported a leak coming from the loft on 31 October 2023 causing mould to form on the ceiling. He reported the leak again on 14 November 2023 and told the landlord that he had mould all around his property. The resident complained to the landlord on 4 December 2023 that the issues he reported were not taken seriously and the damp in the property was worsening. The resident raised his dissatisfaction with the lack of action taken by the landlord in relation to a leak. He explained that the surveyor who attended did not take the issues seriously, the damp on the lower walls in the kitchen and the loft were not inspected, repairs were identified but he was told the landlord could not resolve the loft issues until a pest problem was rectified, the damp in the bedroom was getting worse and mould was starting to show in the bathroom, and the kitchen cupboard was affected and items were damaged by what looked like rising damp. He was unhappy that the property had not been assessed in the 6 years he had lived at the property.

evidence: The resident reported a leak from the loft on 31 October 2023, reported it again on 14 November 2023, and complained on 4 December 2023 that the issues had not been taken seriously and damp was worsening.

The resident escalated the complaint because he was unhappy with the stage 1 resolution, disputed repairs, said the roof was still leaking, and said this affected his mental health.
The landlord’s stage 2 response said an inspection had been completed, it was satisfied repairs had been resolved, but also noted a later roof leak report and said it would attend to repair the roof.
The landlord’s repairs, damp and mould, and complaints policies were considered in assessing its response.

The complaint concerned the landlord’s response to a roof leak including damaged loft insulation, damp and mould, and complaint handling. The resident later said the roof was still leaking, the mould had returned, and the landlord had not contacted him as stated in its final response.
